sources.entry: status-bar-todo - Simple macOS app to keep TODO-list in status bar.

summary.one_liner: A simple macOS menu bar app that keeps a TODO list in the status bar.
summary.what_it_does: The app lives in the macOS status bar and holds a TODO list. It lets you add a TODO, mark or unmark a TODO as completed, edit a single TODO, and delete one TODO or all of them. The README describes these as the app's only tasks, so it is limited in scope. The README includes an empty image placeholder where a screenshot would appear, and gives no further detail on the interface. The repository was listed under the Productivity category of an awesome-style list of open-source macOS apps.
use_cases: keep a simple to-do list in the macOS menu bar
track quick daily tasks without opening a full app
mark off completed tasks from the status bar
edit or delete items on a lightweight personal todo list
how_to_run: Run the project (the README gives no specific build or run commands)
stack: Swift or Objective-C (not stated in README)
notable: Lives entirely in the macOS status bar
Supports add, complete/uncomplete, edit, and bulk delete of TODOs
caveats: The README gives only a bare 'clone and run' installation step with no build instructions
Limited feature set: only the listed task operations are supported
keywords: keep track of tasks on mac
